description: Deletes ONE registrant from a webinar, which is what a deletion request from a participant needs. Side effect: the entry is gone from the site and cannot be brought back, and the person no longer appears in the numbers; their emails are not recalled. Needs `session_id`, `webinar_id`, `lead_id` from wi_list_webinar_leads_registrants and a clear yes (`confirm` true). Read the list first and name the person by name and address, so the wrong entry is not deleted. For clearing a whole list there is no tool here on purpose.

confirm.description: Must be true, set only after the host said that this one person may be deleted.

session_id.description: From an earlier turn (weiter · texte · stand).

webinar_id.description: The webinar (campaign) id, as wi_list_webinars returned it. Never invent an id.

name: wi_delete_registrant
title: Delete one registrant
